_how: Add an item and push. status: shipped | approved | review | testing | waiting | planned. Shipped items need date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM) and type (new | update | fix | site). Unreleased items never get a date.

releases.title: ORB Pro Knightfall MK2 for NinjaTrader 8
releases.body: Native NinjaTrader 8 version of the strategy. Approved by NinjaTrader; final prep for release. Auto Trade on or alert-only, no webhooks or bridge service.

releases.title: Trailing stop and auto breakeven (NT8 v1.1)
releases.body: Off, Breakeven Only, Trail Only, or Breakeven then Trail, matching the TradingView options.

releases.title: TradingView Marketplace move
releases.body: TradingView is moving paid invite-only scripts to its Marketplace. How FSD-X scripts are delivered on TradingView may change. Waiting on TradingView.

releases.title: Indicators on NinjaTrader 8
releases.body: One-to-one NinjaTrader versions of the TradingView indicators, after the strategy port.

releases.title: FSD-X is an official NinjaTrader Ecosystem vendor
releases.body: NinjaTrader approved FSD-X as an Ecosystem vendor and the NinjaTrader 8 version passed review. Release comes after final prep. NinjaTrader 8.

releases.title: Live track record: one continuous timeline
releases.body: The record now runs from Dec 16, 2025 under FSD-X ORB Pro, with version updates marked on the timeline. Each trade shows how it closed and the most it was up before closing. View the record.

releases.title: Fleet accounts
releases.body: Track a whole fleet of eval and funded accounts in one place on the Accounts page.

releases.title: Raven launched
releases.body: Same ORB detection, stop and target engine as Knightfall, with no grading or filtering. Every breakout is drawn both ways and the read is yours. About Raven.

releases.title: Nightwing tools subscription
releases.body: The member platform and Nexus 2.0 on their own, without the full membership. About Nightwing.

releases.title: Free Indicators page
releases.body: A home for the free scripts, starting with the Arkham ORB Indicator. Free Indicators.

releases.title: Knightfall MK2 backtest data refreshed
releases.body: Lookahead fixes and the day-start side lockout. Backtest research data republished from the new exports.

releases.title: Nexus 2.0.47
releases.body: Nexus now knows which plan you're on and only shows the features that come with it.

releases.title: Knightfall MK2 goes live
releases.body: ORB Pro rebuilt as a strategy, replacing the v5 indicator. Grades, stops and targets are handled by the engine.

releases.title: ORB Pro v5
releases.body: The indicator version of ORB Pro that ran into spring 2026.
